title: Pure Garbage
summary: Pure Garbage build centered on Dr. Faker's DARK Fiend trio—Garbage Lord, Garbage Ogre, and Garbage Golem—paired with Tour Guide From the Underworld and Rank 5 DARK Xyz bosses. Because Garbage Lord's hand Special Summon has no once-per-turn limit, the deck floods Level 5 DARK Fiends to make Adreus, Number 53: Heart-eartH, and D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex.

summary.title: Starters
points: Garbage Ogre sends itself from the hand to the GY to search Garbage Lord from the Deck.
Tour Guide From the Underworld summons Sangan or Garbage Ogre from the Deck; linking Sangan into Muckraker From the Underworld triggers Sangan to search Garbage Lord, Garbage Ogre, or Garbage Golem.
Foolish Burial dumps Garbage Golem directly to the GY so its GY banish effect is live, while Allure of Darkness digs two cards deeper.

summary.title: Opening: Tour Guide or Garbage Ogre + Level 5 Extender
steps: Normal Summon Tour Guide From the Underworld and Special Summon Sangan from the Deck.
Link Summon Muckraker From the Underworld using Tour Guide and Sangan; Sangan searches Garbage Ogre (or Garbage Lord directly).
Send Garbage Ogre from the hand to the GY to search a second Garbage Lord, then pay 2000 LP per copy to Special Summon two Level 5 Garbage Lords from the hand.
Overlay both Garbage Lords into D/D/D Marksman King Tell and rank up directly into Rank 10 D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex (or overlay into Number 53: Heart-eartH).

summary.title: Garbage Lord & Garbage Golem
summary.text: Garbage Lord pays 2000 LP to Special Summon itself from the hand with no once-per-turn restriction, though it can only be used as Xyz Material for the Xyz Summon of a DARK monster. Because Garbage Lord has 0 ATK, Garbage Golem can Special Summon itself from the hand while you control it. On the field, Garbage Golem can reveal 3 Xyz Monsters with different Ranks in your Extra Deck to destroy itself and a card on the field (locking you to Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck for the turn); in the GY, it banishes itself to detach 1 Xyz Material from your monster and revive a 0 ATK or 0 DEF monster—bringing back Garbage Lord or a 0 ATK/0 DEF Number 53: Heart-eartH.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: D/D/D Marksman King Tell and D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex satisfy Garbage Lord's DARK Xyz restriction: Machinex stacks directly over Marksman King Tell and detaches 2 materials whenever an opponent's Monster Card activates its effect on the field to attach that monster to itself as Xyz Material.

Number 53: Heart-eartH (0 ATK / 0 DEF) gains the original ATK of any monster that attacks it, detaches a material to survive destruction, and when destroyed by a card effect while it has no materials, Special Summons Number 92: Heart-eartH Dragon from the Extra Deck and attaches itself as material.

Number 92: Heart-eartH Dragon cannot be destroyed by battle, reflects all battle damage involving itself back to the opponent, and detaches 1 material during the opponent's End Phase to banish every card they Normal/Special Summoned or Set that turn.
Adreus, Keeper of Armageddon detaches 1 material to destroy a face-up card the opponent controls, while Xyz Armor Fortress overlays onto Rank 3 or 4 plays.

allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Normal Summon starter that summons Level 3 DARK Fiend Garbage Ogre or Sangan from the Deck.
allow.Sangan: Level 3 DARK Fiend that searches Garbage Ogre, Garbage Golem, or Garbage Lord (all have 1500 or less ATK!) when linked off.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Garbage Golem directly to the GY to trigger its GY banish effect (detaching 1 material to revive Garbage Lord).
allow.Allure of Darkness: Draws 2 cards and banishes excess DARK Fiends.
allow.Number 53: Heart-eartH: Dr. Faker's signature Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz (0 ATK / 0 DEF!) made with Level 5 Garbage Lords that floats into Number 92: Heart-eartH Dragon.
allow.Number 92: Heart-eartH Dragon: Rank 9 DARK Dragon Xyz (0 ATK / 0 DEF) cheated out by Number 53 that reflects battle damage and banishes the opponent's board.
allow.Adreus, Keeper of Armageddon: Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz summonable using two Level 5 Garbage Lords (satisfying Garbage Lord's DARK Xyz restriction) that detaches 1 material to destroy a face-up card.
allow.D/D/D Marksman King Tell: Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz that can be ranked up or summoned to burn and send Garbage Golem from the Deck to the GY.
allow.D/D/D Deviser King Deus Machinex: Rank 10 DARK Fiend Xyz that stacks directly over any D/D/D Xyz (Marksman King Tell) to absorb opposing monsters when they activate effects.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 DARK Fiend that discards a card to revive Garbage Lord or Garbage Golem from the GY.
allow.K9-66X \"Jacks\": K9-66X "Jacks": Endboard boss featured on page analysis.
allow.Xyz Armor Fortress: Armored Xyz bridge that searches full Armored Xyz package upon overlaying.

main: Level 5 DARK Fiend (0 ATK / 2400 DEF) that pays 2000 LP to Special Summon itself from the hand (not once per turn!) to assemble Rank 5 DARK Xyz monsters.
Level 3 DARK Fiend that sends itself from your hand to the GY to add 1 Garbage Lord from your Deck to your hand.

Level 4 DARK Fiend: Special Summons itself while you control a 0 ATK/DEF monster (Garbage Lord), reveals 3 different-Rank Xyz to pop itself and a card, and banishes from GY to detach 1 Xyz Material and revive a 0 ATK/DEF monster.
Level 2 Cyberse that bounces another Cyberse or acts as an archetypal Garbage name.
Summons Sangan or Garbage Ogre from the Deck to link into Muckraker From the Underworld and search Garbage Lord.
Searches Garbage Lord (0 ATK), Garbage Ogre (800 ATK), or Garbage Golem when sent from the field to the GY.
Draws 2 cards by banishing a DARK Fiend.
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Garbage Golem or Garbage Lord to the GY.
extra: Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz (2 Level 5 monsters) valid under Garbage Lord's DARK restriction; detaches 1 material to destroy 1 face-up card the opponent controls.
Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz (0 ATK / 0 DEF—valid revival target for Garbage Golem!) that gains attacking monsters' ATK and cheats out Number 92 when destroyed without materials.
Rank 9 DARK Dragon Xyz summoned by Number 53 that banishes all cards Normal/Special Summoned or Set by the opponent this turn.
Rank 5 DARK Fiend Xyz that detaches 1 material when you take effect damage to burn for 1000 and sends a Fiend to GY when sent to GY.
Rank 10 DARK Fiend Xyz stacked over Marksman King Tell that detaches 2 materials (or destroys a Dark Contract) to attach an opponent's monster that activates an effect.
Link-2 DARK Fiend that revives Garbage Lord or Garbage Golem from the GY.
Rank 4: Machine Xyz that detaches materials to protect and pop cards.
Rank 5: stacks on Rank 3 or 4 Xyz, searches Armored Xyz cards from Deck up to its materials, and attaches from GY.
